verdict.rationale: LobeHub advertises an "IM Gateway — Agents where you already chat", and its usage docs include a Messenger section with dedicated pages for Telegram, Slack, and Discord, so users can reach their agents outside the web app. The evidence consists only of marketing taglines and doc navigation titles, not setup detail. Missing for 10: WhatsApp and iMessage support, in-depth setup documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
